authority: Located construction/renewal comparison. No selected receiver, metal, support, joint, level or capacity.

location.disposition: Conditional garden test candidate; no site territory established

retainedBody.wetBody: One qualified continuous body between deliberate hydraulic/movement divisions; no selected length
retainedBody.proposedRestraint: Defined fixed datum near terminal, sliding seats elsewhere; exact design unproved
retainedBody.largerRepair: Qualified consumptive local repair or release of terminal/retainers and larger body renewal

separateTrays.mechanism: Individually watertight bodies with visible open transfers; not sealed ordinary laps

variables.zLip: Actual outlet-lip elevation of tray i, including offsets and sheet thickness
variables.ZWater: Governing downstream receiving-water elevation at transfer i
variables.g: Positive evidenced free separation; no selected value
variables.h: Non-negative downstream water depth above its entry floor
variables.F: Non-negative fall from each tray entry floor to its outlet lip
variables.Delta: Step from upstream outlet lip down to downstream entry floor
variables.D: Total available drop from first entry floor to last outlet lip

separateTrays.serialDrop: D = sum(F_i) + sum(Delta_i) >= sum(F_i) + sum(h_i+1 + g_i)
separateTrays.transferCount: n - 1 for a serial chain of n trays
separateTrays.rejection: For n > 1, zero available drop cannot accommodate positive free separations and non-negative falls/depths.
separateTrays.limit: Check actual lip/invert datums and permitted movement. A raised lip giving negative F lies outside this comparator; a local raised lip may still pond with positive F. The final lip-to-terminal gap and onward receiving drop lie outside D. Losing free separation under backwater invalidates this free-transfer claim, not every possible submerged gravity route.

sourceMechanisms.C11: CDA 10.3F: fixed soldered copper transverse seams for its watertight condition
sourceMechanisms.C12: CDA 10.5B: separately moving receiving gutter; 10.5C/D are different joined arrangements

seamSupportContinuation.authority: Authored local seam-support and dry-edge keeper comparison; not an installed bearing or whole-body release result.
seamSupportContinuation.location: Outer-west R1 wet body; local longitudinal coordinate s measured from a separately supported dry-side terminal-station datum. No global seam station, body length or capture width selected.

construction.seam: Develop a mechanically locked and soldered copper cross-seam; its sheet-to-sheet continuity does not anchor it to the substrate.
construction.support: 40 mm installation-temperature support-demand footprint is an authored screen, not a recovered folded/riveted underside. Profiled contact, support of adjacent sheet, capacity and friction remain unresolved.
construction.fixedDatum: A separately supported, releasable dry-side restraint at s=0; the soldered outlet seam is not the anchorage or lifting connection.
construction.keepers: Removable dry-side top caps retain an authored folded-edge envelope without through-fixing the wet liner. Along-run sliding, vertical capture and eventual cap removal are different actions.
construction.terminal: Retain an open receiving transition as the distinct R1 development case. It is not a qualified capture or free-discharge result. A rigid connection at another station changes the restraint system.
construction.transverse: Cross-width movement, actual folded edge, contacts, restraint and uplift loads are not resolved by this longitudinal comparison.

inputs.attribution: Only alpha is from the Aurubis architectural comparison (printed p81). Gauge, footprint, temperatures, positioning and seat are authored. The installation error changes the gauge and the footprint also expands.
inputs.supportMotion: Stationary seat and fixed datum. Actual frame temperature, expansion, settlement and deflection require a relative-motion model.

secondRigidAnchor.consequence: A separately rigid terminal at s=300 cannot share the zero-displacement assumption at s=0. Restraint stress, compliant connection or changed fixed zone requires design; no failure capacity is calculated.

fixedAtSeamAlternative.consequence: Greater local coverage does not make this the preferred restraint: the terminal would now move relative to its receiver or pipe. Keep the original terminal-station datum until that different connection is designed.

authoredSection.holeAndStud: Coaxial cylindrical 8 mm hole and 6 mm stud, centre v=40/s=0; no thread or fastener capacity inferred.

dryEdgeKeeper.scope: Complete axial cap passage through the authored coaxial cylindrical hole is clear, then a 65 mm outward translation clears the stud by 17 mm horizontally. Nut and upper units are already removed. Working space is authored empty; tools, fastener access, force, corrosion, deposits and capacity remain unverified.

prerequisites: Qualified incoming-water diversion and a protected work area
Independent temporary support for the actual wet body
Independent grate/impact units removed and safely staged
Terminal and all carried tail/flange projections freed
Every sliding/uplift cap removed or retracted
eventualRepair.localResult: The authored keeper has a finite first release; the retained-cap control prevents a direct 5 mm liner lift. This does not demonstrate complete wet-body extraction.
eventualRepair.terminalCondition: A retained aperture needs clearance for the maximum carried tail/flange envelope, not just the stem: opening > carried width + 2*abs(offset) for this straight-lift screen. Actual dimensions are unknown.
eventualRepair.localSeamRepair: A soldered seam is not released by removing its keeper. A qualified local repair may consume metal and needs sound accessible copper, cleanup, heating protection and reinstatement; larger renewal remains a separate operation.

C9.use: Architectural expansion coefficient; fixed/moving zones; supporting gutter frame; movement at outlet. Roof construction guidance, not this ground receiver or a prescribed seam-only bearing.

C11.use: Free lining movement, locked/soldered or riveted/soldered seams, outside-frame fabrication/inspection. No smooth-underside, bare sliding bearing or UK installed-system approval.

unresolved: Support loads, restraint, movement, wear and every retained accessory
Receiver widths, roof discharge/capture, splash, flow and debris
Every receiving-water elevation, free separation, fall and terminal level
Harmless leakage/overflow paths and real site territory
Complete first-motion, handling and reinstatement demonstration
